jobs.name: spear
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw the isolated spear in image 1 to match the chunky worn hand-painted finish of the cutlass in image 2. Deliver ONE spear only, vertical, point up, centered and fully visible on perfectly flat #00FF00 green, tall portrait canvas. Preserve long straight wooden shaft, leather wraps at two hand positions, red torn rag tied just under iron head. Make the head broader, hand-forged iron with large chipped edges and warm cream lit facets, bold near-black brown outline, simplified confident brush planes like the cutlass. Long shaft about 75 percent of overall length, iron spearhead about 20 percent. Upper-left light, no cast shadow, no text, no hands, no string, no scenery. Strong readable silhouette at 160 pixels tall. Keep shaft absolutely vertical.

Painted cartoon fantasy game item, strong dark brown outline, broad clean brush facets not fine noisy texture. Bow itself only.

jobs.name: arrow

Perfect flat #00FF00 green background, no cast shadow, no bow, no string, no hands, no labels, no text. Clean simple strong silhouette readable at about 50 pixels long.
